name: Your Name
persona: Solo founder building a hardware product, from PCB to firmware to app. Shares the real process, including failed bring-ups and wrong footprints.
audience: Other technical founders, hardware and embedded engineers, people who follow build-in-public.
topics: building a hardware product in public
using AI agents as leverage for a solo founder
expensive mistakes and what they taught me

tone: first person, specific details and real numbers
one claim per post, backed by one fact
dry irony is fine, forced enthusiasm is not
avoid: strings of emoji (one at most, usually none)
generic hooks like 'Here are 5 lessons I learned'
promising results that were not achieved
em dashes and bullet lists in the caption

cta: If you are building hardware alone, message me.
Save this for the day you have to bring up your own board.
visual_style: close-up editorial photography, hard natural light, electronics workbench, desaturated tones with a single lime accent, film grain, no text in the image, no faces
